summary: ePlus inc. filed an 8-K to announce quarterly financial results for Q4 and FY2026 and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 17, 2026. The dividend represents a capital return to shareholders; no special situation like acquisition or restructuring is present. The company also provided FY2027 guidance. Filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement; there are no deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks. Watch for future dividend policy changes or capital allocation updates.
